screenLevelIssues.explanation: The Simulator shows the selected credit card as a standard list item row. The Figma design specifies a completely different, rich UI component for the selected state: a 270x400px card with a dark textured background, Visa logo, large card number typography, and a distinct footer section.
screenLevelIssues.currentCode: // Code file missing, but Simulator shows generic list item
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
// Implementation required based on Figma tree:
<View style={{ width: 270, height: 400, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: '#202020' }}>
  {/* Main Card Body (Height: 336) */}
  <View style={{ padding: 24, flex: 1 }}>
    <VisaLogo />
    <Text style={{ fontSize: 20, fontFamily: 'PlusJakartaSans-Regular', marginTop: 120, color: '#FF9A6D' }}>•••• 2341</Text>
    <View style={{ marginTop: 28 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#4D4D4D' }}>EXPIRY <Text style={{ color: '#FF9A6D' }}>06/26</Text></Text>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#4D4D4D', marginTop: 8 }}>CVV <Text style={{ color: '#FF9A6D' }}>•••</Text></Text>
    </View>
  </View>
  {/* Footer (Height: 64) */}
  <View style={{ height: 64, backgroundColor: '#1A1A1A', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 32 }}>
    <Text style={{ color: '#CBCBCB', fontSize: 14 }}>CREDIT CARD</Text>
    <Icon name='pencil' size={16} color='#CBCBCB' style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />
  </View>
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The card component requires a specific background stack: Base #202020, Image overlay (opacity 0.16), and Solid #000000 overlay (opacity 0.64). The current implementation lacks this visual depth.
Figma uses specific typography for the card details (20px for number, 16px for expiry/cvv) with specific color highlighting (#FF9A6D). The simulator uses standard list text styles.

feedback.explanation: Re-implement the selected credit card component. The current implementation is a generic list item, but Figma requires a 270x400px rich card with specific dark theme colors and typography.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={{ width: 270, height: 400, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: colors.black[500], overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  {/* Main Body */}
  <View style={{ padding: 24, flex: 1 }}>
    {/* Header Placeholder for Absolute Elements */}
    <View style={{ height: 40, marginBottom: 80 }} />
    
    {/* Card Number */}
    <Text style={{ ...typography.bodyLg, color: colors.brand[500], fontFamily: 'PlusJakartaSans-Regular' }}>•••• 2341</Text>
    
    {/* Details */}
    <View style={{ marginTop: 28 }}>
      <Text style={{ ...typography.bodyMdRegular, color: colors.black[400] }}>EXPIRY <Text style={{ color: colors.brand[500] }}>06/26</Text></Text>
      <Text style={{ ...typography.bodyMdRegular, color: colors.black[400], marginTop: 8 }}>CVV <Text style={{ color: colors.brand[500] }}>•••</Text></Text>
    </View>
  </View>
  
  {/* Footer */}
  <View style={{ height: 64, backgroundColor: colors.black[600], flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 32 }}>
    <Text style={{ color: colors.neutral[300], fontSize: 14 }}>CREDIT CARD</Text>
    <Icon name='pencil' size={16} color={colors.neutral[300]} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />
  </View>
</View>
